HVO standby gensets: 128 MW ÷ 2.75 MW per unit = 46.4 → 47 units; 47 units form 5 blocks (block size 10); N+1 adds 5; total 52 units (143 MW).
Fuel storage: 128 MW × 48 h × 0.26 L/kWh = 1,593 m³ (1,338 t).
Small modular reactor (firm prime): 100 % of steady-state average facility load 96.4 MW = 96.4 MW → 1 × 80 MW = 80.0 MW; available from month 120.
Grid connection: offered import capacity per period (20.0 MW → 120 MW), the same for every option and never resized. Connection capex on 120 MW at full connection (HV band, AIS).
Grid shortfall at design load, months 21–29: design load 32.7 MW less 0.0 MW firm on site less 20.0 MW grid leaves up to 12.7 MW; dispatched as unmet load under "Show unmet load".
Grid shortfall at design load, months 55–119: design load 137 MW less 0.0 MW firm on site less 120 MW grid leaves up to 16.7 MW; dispatched as unmet load under "Show unmet load".

Grid cable route: 10 m from the POC (default: the access point, standing in for the road side; replace with the real POC) to the buildable envelope, straight line, × €1.50 m/km = €15,000 (in the grid connection capex).
